when.t: A mention on a monitored channel is labelled mixed, or has no label and contains an angry or negative phrase.

steps.t: Agent 20 treats it as a complaint.
For a complaint, Agent 20 logs the mention word for word, raises a complaint alert quoting it, and asks Agent 11 to hold every message to that thread except the one opt-out confirmation.
steps.src: dispatcher/listing_spokes_20.py:154-158, 160-195; dispatcher/listing_spokes_11.py::if ctx in self.complaint_hold and template != "opt_out_confirmed":

steps.t: The hold stays until the authorized user releases it.
The kind of mention (question, complaint, praise, lead, mixed) is a label on the incoming mention; without one, Agent 20 checks only for angry or negative phrases, which make it a complaint.

never.t: Treat a mixed mention as praise.

you_see.t: A complaint alert quoting the post.

test.t: "Great house but the agent never called me back." labelled mixed; "Furious with how this listing was handled." with no label.

title.t: A mention may involve a client

when.t: A complaint is marked as possibly involving a client whose identity is not confirmed.

steps.t: The complaint alert says the identity is not confirmed or asserted, and names no one.
A question with the same mark goes to Agent 11 as a "team will follow up" message with the same note, not to Agent 01 as a lead.
For a complaint, Agent 20 logs the mention word for word, raises a complaint alert quoting it, and asks Agent 11 to hold every message to that thread except the one opt-out confirmation.
steps.src: dispatcher/listing_spokes_20.py:154-158, 160-195; dispatcher/listing_spokes_11.py::if ctx in self.complaint_hold and template != "opt_out_confirmed":

never.t: Confirm or suggest that the person is a client.

you_see.t: A complaint alert noting the identity is not confirmed.

test.t: "Still waiting on my closing papers from these people.", labelled complaint and marked as possibly a client.

title.t: A negative thread is going viral

steps.t: The complaint alert carries viral priority.
No reply is drafted, even with reply templates set.
For a complaint, Agent 20 logs the mention word for word, raises a complaint alert quoting it, and asks Agent 11 to hold every message to that thread except the one opt-out confirmation.
steps.src: dispatcher/listing_spokes_20.py:154-158, 160-195; dispatcher/listing_spokes_11.py::if ctx in self.complaint_hold and template != "opt_out_confirmed":

never.t: Draft a reply to a viral negative thread (Agent 20 drafts no reply to any complaint).

test.t: "Worst brokerage in town, do not use them!" labelled complaint and viral, with reply templates set.

steps.t: Agent 20 logs it. Nothing is posted.

With a praise reply template set, it drafts the template's reply, sends it to Compliance, and if cleared holds it for the authorized user to post themselves; a template with pricing or legal words is refused with a legal-line alert instead. Without a template, nothing else.

never.t: Reply or engage on its own.

test.t: "Loved working with this team!", with no praise template set.

title.t: A question comes in publicly or by direct message

when.t: A mention labelled question arrives on a monitored channel, public or direct message.

steps.t: Either way Agent 20 sends it to Agent 01 as a lead signal, with the channel and the words, and consent unknown.
The channel rides in the message itself.
Agent 01 captures it and Agent 02, with nothing to score, asks the authorized user.
steps.src: flow:20-05:01->02 lead.captured; flow:20-05:02->queue clarification.request; dispatcher/listing_spokes_20.py:222-228; dispatcher/lead_rubric.py:86

steps.t: With a question template set, a draft reply also goes to Compliance; if Compliance clears it, it goes to the authorized user to post (a flagged draft is dropped, and a template with pricing or legal words is refused before review).

never.t: Answer the question on its own.

you_see.t: A new lead held by Agent 02 for the authorized user.

test.t: "Is the Elm Street house still available?" on Facebook publicly and by direct message.

why.t: An owner deferral note, not a decision: the social phase comes later.
